analysis.nfr1: Security: Ensure strict data privacy so that students cannot view other students' schedules under any circumstances.
analysis.nfr2: Auditability: Maintain a secure system log of every manual prerequisite override performed by advisors for audit purposes.
analysis.nfr3: Usability: Provide an intuitive, visual drag-and-drop interface to simplify roadmap planning and replace the current complex catalog.
